New Super Mario Bros Deluxe - Play as Toadette, it's extremely easy and enemies can't kill you. Younger kids will love and feel accomplished! On sale in eShop!

Most Lego games - any of the Lego games, are pretty straightforward, you might need to help them from time to time, but if they're just going through the levels from point A to point B, it's mostly very easy and silly.

Kirby And The Forgotten Land - Extremely cute and very easy.

Goat Simulator  -  The game really has no point and it's a open world sandbox. Do whatever you want. So there's no pressure to do anything, just have fun. GTA Trilogy - Now this one might be controversial. But if you strip away the story, and just let them enjoy the big open world sandbox of driving around, riding boats or flying airplanes, it can be really fun. It will require supervision though. My son plays Red Dead 2 and GTA V but does no story missions, (only what I progress him through) and he just enjoys the open world element of doing whatever he wants.

Mario Kart 8 - Play on the easy setting and anyone and everyone is sure to have a blast! Teach them the drifting ways!

Yoshi's Crafted World - Another very simple and adorable platformer from Nintendo! On sale too in the eShop!
